stage: Stationary extruded airfoil on two levels, open coarse boundaries, fine Bouzidi wall, integrated loads and restart

scope.flow: Existing low-Mach Re=1e4..1e5 Flow contract, CPU float64, no explicit SGS in this milestone
scope.coarse_outer: Prescribed freestream west/north/south, history-dependent extrapolation east, periodic span
scope.fine_wall: All body surfaces on fine level, stationary no-slip linear Bouzidi, true periodic fine span
scope.ownership: Solid fine cells and all covered coarse cells excluded from fluid integrals; virtual covered interior never supplies physical donor stencils
scope.geometry_guard: At least four coarse-cell widths from every wall to the x/y fine interface; retain three coarse fluid rows for donor prediction
scope.time: dx_f=dx_c/2 and dt_f=dt_c/2; force history is average of both fine momentum-transfer intervals, labelled at coarse-interval midpoint
scope.checkpoint: Both levels, counters, all CPU fields and structured boundary history, at synchronized times only
scope.not_claimed: DNS, high-Re or M=0.4, aerodynamic convergence, validated Cl/Cd/Cm, native Windows/GPU

wall_link_geometry.require: Each positive-q link crosses the exact contour at that fraction

closed_surface_isotropic_pressure.require: Force and moment cancel on a closed extruded wall; physical span excludes fine donor layers

stationary_fractional_flat_wall_shear_de.require: Independent analytic sine-mode decay with non-halfway Bouzidi walls and the same pre-collision ordering

symmetric_naca0012_alpha0_startup.require: Cd positive, finite flow and exactly two fine wall applications per accepted coarse step

force_units_and_time.require: Independent impulse/area normalization and arbitrary-reference moment transformation

open_domain_balance.require: Use actual external PDF flux and actual wall exchange; do not infer conservation from mean density

criteria_fixed_before_execution.wall_mass_leakage: Measure and report separately. The open-domain budget identity does not certify impermeability accuracy of interpolated bounce-back; grid convergence remains required.

virtual_interior_isolation.require: Changing the unused virtual interior fill must not change owned coarse/fine fluid evolution with the required guard

criteria_fixed_before_execution.diagnostics_do_not_advance_boundaries: Repeated diagnostics/export must leave PDFs and outflow history unchanged

checkpoint.require: Continuous versus restored evolution, exact counters, structured outflow history restored; malformed/changed-case checkpoints rejected

criteria_fixed_before_execution.run_output: New output only, uniform force sampling times, actual two-grid NPZ/PNG/GIF, stop/resume without mixed history
criteria_fixed_before_execution.experiment: Export preliminary Ohtake Re=30000 Cl comparison at alpha=5 after a named short startup interval. Explicitly inconclusive for aerodynamic accuracy; Cd/Cm unavailable in this low-Re reference.
criteria_fixed_before_execution.offline: Installed wheel from unchanged pinned local dependencies, fresh JIT cache, blocked Python socket/DNS, relevant tests and actual airfoil run/export/restart
criteria_fixed_before_execution.regression: Retain the prior periodic interface flux, equilibrium, subcycling and transport checks when adding extension hooks
